laws.rule: Lecce charges an imposta di soggiorno (tourist tax) to non-residents per person per night, for up to 5 consecutive nights (7 for short-term rentals). Rates from 1 April 2026 (Giunta resolution 46 of 20 February 2026), high season 1 April to 31 October / low season 1 November to 31 March: 5-star hotels EUR 5 / EUR 4; 4-star EUR 4.50 / EUR 3; 1 to 3-star hotels EUR 4 / EUR 2; B&Bs, rooms, holiday flats, agritourism, hostels, campsites EUR 3 / EUR 2; short-term rentals EUR 2.50 / EUR 1.50. The range is about A$2.38 to A$7.95 (A$1 = EUR 0.6293, RBA 30 October 2026). Residents, under-12s, coach drivers, one tour escort per 20 group members, and hospital carers are exempt.
laws.penalty_signal: EUR 1.50 to EUR 5 per person per night (about A$2.38 to A$7.95)

laws.rule: Lecce's Police Regulation (Regolamento di Polizia Urbana, council resolution 11 of 21 March 2017) Art. 17, comma 1, letter e, bans lying down, sitting, eating, drinking or sleeping in a plainly indecent way on public ground, at places of worship and remembrance, on monument steps, benches and building thresholds. Where no other law applies, Art. 17 sets a fine of EUR 50 to EUR 300 (about A$79 to A$477 (A$1 = EUR 0.6293, RBA 30 October 2026)).
laws.penalty_signal: EUR 50 to EUR 300 (about A$79 to A$477)
